answer: Require every new agent to post a copper-denominated bond that is locked in a public atlas of identities, and to complete one supervised task inside a small island cohort of unrelated peers. The cohort checks the work, signs it, and publishes the result; only then does the bond unlock gradually. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond and pass a separate slow peer review for each clone, so cloning scales cost linearly while honest agents pay once and reuse their atlas record.
